artifact_scope: Small development smoke digest; all cells are emitted by --output, no event export
cost_interpretation: Assumed round-trip sensitivities subtracted once; not measured fees, fills, funding or P&L

cost_scenarios_bps.12: Two assumed 6 bp taker fees; historical fee constancy is unverified.
cost_scenarios_bps.22: 12 bp plus 10 bp assumed round-trip spread/slippage.
cost_scenarios_bps.37: 12 bp plus 25 bp assumed round-trip spread/slippage.

count_unit: Arm/side/symbol signal x horizon disposition, not independent samples. Pooled totals sum all three horizons. Boundary rejects may appear in both adjacent fold counters; no completed outcome is reused across folds.
dependence: Events overlap and are dependent; floors do not establish power or independence
entry_price_limitation: Next-open outcomes are hypothetical OHLCV descriptors, NOT evidence of a post-signal executable price. The separately verified bounded G01 diagnostic found all 12 inspected AAPL 5m opens equal the previous official close and last observed pre-boundary trade, not the first observed in-bucket trade; adjacent receive partitions supplied no late target-hour events. This does not establish an executable entry or a universal candle convention, and does not change any frozen arm, protocol, or outcome formula.
inferential_analysis: NOT_RUN; no p-values, intervals, or market-validity claims
reserved_fold_policy: Never loaded or evaluated; development folds cannot satisfy future gates
signal_close_entry_convention: Signal timestamp is candle open; signal close and next candle entry-open share the boundary signal_timestamp + bar_ms, per the frozen explicit timestamp formula. They are separate price observations, not distinct clock instants.
unresolved_protocol_ambiguities: The prose 'strictly after signal close' conflicts with adjacent-candle signal-close/next-open clock equality. Development code follows the explicit entry_timestamp = signal_timestamp + one bar formula; the protocol is not amended.
